text:
Mike G: Quick preflight for Wed's webinar — can we lock roles and recording plan? Thinking: host, producer (Zoom ops), local backup, clip owner, and post-event follow-up owner.

Tina Chen: I'm happy to be host. I'll do intro + 15m demo and handle Q&A handoff.

Evan: I can be producer / Zoom ops. I'll set up alternative hosts and co-hosts. Need final panelist list by EOD Monday.

Jamal S: I'll own clips + editing. After recording, I'll pull 3x 60-90s highlight clips for the nurture flow.

Mike G: Great. @Evan — list of Zoom settings we need:
- Cloud recording enabled (record active speaker + gallery + shared screen)
- Enable original sound for presenters
- Disable waiting room (we'll use passcode)
- Auto-record to cloud + local backup on one laptop
- Enable live transcript

Evan: Got it. I'll also enable "Record audio only" fallback in case the video stream drops. I'll add an RTMP fallback to our backup RTMP ingest (rtmp://ingest.redwood-demo/backup) so if cloud recording fails we still get a stream.

ops-bot: Recording retention policy for marketing recordings set to 90 days (was 30 days).

Tina Chen: Do we have captions vendor set? We should turn on Zoom auto-captions and also upload the recorded VTT to Otter for correction before clips.

Jamal S: Otter works. I'll do a first-pass clean up and export SRT/VTT. ETA 24 hrs after event.

Leah (Marketing): For post-event: We want immediate replay email (within 30 min) to registrants + a short survey link. I'm drafting copy: one liner highlight, 3 clips, CTA -> product trial + request demo.

Mike G: Copy sounds good. Who's owning the replay email send? And lead routing?

Leah (Marketing): I'll own the send. For lead routing: put registrant + attendee lists into SFDC via our Zapier flow. High-intent attendees (questions asked + >30m watch) to AE queue. I'll add tags: webinar:product-launch, clip-interest.

Evan: Note: need to enable cloud recording passcode and include recording URL in post-send. Zoom only publishes after processing — usually ~15-25 min. We'll need the S3 webhook to be connected so clip pipeline can pull the file as soon as it lands.

Jamal S: Already added the S3 trigger to the clip lambda. It's in staging: /ops/clip-pipeline -> will pick new recordings, generate thumbnails, transcribe.

Mike G: Checklist before Wed:
- [ ] Final panelist list (EOD Mon) -> @Tina Chen
- [ ] Zoom settings applied + RTMP configured -> @Evan
- [ ] Local backup laptop assigned -> @Evan
- [ ] Clip owner + S3 trigger verified -> @Jamal S
- [ ] Replay email copy and flow tested -> @Leah (Marketing)
- [ ] SFDC/Zap mapping approved -> @Leah (Marketing)

Tina Chen: I'll post the panelist bios + slides in #marketing by Tue noon.

Evan: I'll do one dry-run Tuesday 9am PT with presenters (10-15 min), check audio/video, and validate RTMP failover.

Leah (Marketing): I'll schedule the replay email in MailerLite as "manual send" so we can double-check Zoom link post-processing.

Mike G: Perfect. One more: permissions — make sure the recording S3 object ACL allows our clip pipeline service account. @ops-bot can you double-check?

ops-bot: Confirmed: clip-pipeline-sa has s3:GetObject and s3:GetObjectVersion on marketing-recordings/*

Mike G: Thanks all. I'll update the event doc with these assignments and ping again after the dry-run. :thumbsup:
